Applications must be submitted online on or before 04-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Bombay to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Bombay Technical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the IIT Bombay Technical Officer (Scale I) posts is September 4, 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Technical Officer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for the Technical Officer (Scale I) position at IIT Bombay.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.Tech/B.E/MCA/M.Sc/M.Tech in a relevant discipline with at least 55% marks and relevant experience as specified for each post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Technical Officer position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Technical Officer (Scale I) posts is 40 years, with age relaxation applicable as per institute norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Technical Officer role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary in Pay Level 10, ranging from Rs. 56,100 to Rs. 177,500 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is Rs. 500.

faq.question: Q7. Are there any application fees for SC/ST and Women candidates?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for SC/ST and Women candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the IIT Bombay recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for the IIT Bombay Technical Officer posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official IIT Bombay website on or before the last date.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.
